nodes.name: .gitattributes
nodes.summary: Git attributes file normalizing all text/source files to LF line endings cross-platform and marking binary asset types (png, rds, rda, qs) so they are never normalized.

nodes.name: copilot-instructions.md
nodes.summary: GitHub Copilot guidance for the hoopR package covering project context, repository workflow, code style, the httr2 HTTP/proxy layer, cli messaging, function naming, roxygen documentation, and testing conventions.

nodes.name: bug_report.md
nodes.summary: GitHub issue template for reporting bugs in hoopR, prompting for the affected function/parameters, a reprex, expected behavior, error output, and session info.

nodes.name: feature_request.md
nodes.summary: GitHub issue template for proposing a new function, endpoint, or improvement, with prompts for the desired solution, NBA Stats API endpoint details, and alternatives considered.

nodes.name: PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
nodes.summary: Pull request template structuring contributions with summary, type-of-change, related issues, changes made, submission/testing checklists, and reviewer checklist sections.

nodes.name: .Rbuildignore
nodes.summary: R CMD build ignore list excluding non-package files (data-raw, vignettes source, docs, CI config, CLAUDE.md, tooling, and dev artifacts) from the built tarball.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Scoping config for the understand-anything knowledge-graph indexer that keeps R source, data-raw generators, vignettes, and CI while excluding tests, generated man pages, bundled data, and binary artifacts.

nodes.name: gap_analysis.md
nodes.summary: Coverage gap analysis comparing the Python nba_api endpoints (146) against hoopR's nba_* exports (184), listing missing endpoints by priority, deprecation candidates, and hoopR-only extras.

nodes.name: get_exported_functions.R
nodes.summary: Developer data-prep script using pkgapi to map the package, extract exported function definitions and their parameters, and write CSV manifests of exported functions and nba_ stats parameters.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses pkgapi::map_package() to introspect exports and self-calls across the package.

nodes.name: intro-to-hoopR.Rmd
nodes.summary: R Markdown tutorial walking new users through acquiring KenPom men's college basketball data with hoopR, including configuring KP_USER/KP_PW credentials and the kp_ scraping functions.

nodes.name: markdown_man_table_helper.R
nodes.summary: Authoring helper snippets that emit column-name/type markdown tables and roxygen documentation blocks for NBA Stats data frames, easing manual @return table maintenance.

nodes.name: mbb_teams.R
nodes.summary: Short exploratory script joining NCAA men's basketball team listings with ESPN MBB teams to reconcile team-name keys across sources.

nodes.name: PR_devel.md
nodes.summary: Drafted pull-request writeup documenting a development PR's new functions, bug fixes, documentation, infrastructure changes, and testing notes for the devel branch.

nodes.name: pull_coach_links.R
nodes.summary: KenPom scraping script that logs in and parses a team page to extract coach names and profile link references, building a coaches reference table.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses rvest session_jump_to over an authenticated KenPom browser session to harvest .coach link nodes.

nodes.name: pull_nba_teams.R
nodes.summary: Data generator that pulls NBA league standings via nba_leaguestandingsv3, joins to ESPN NBA teams, and writes the bundled nba_teams dataset with usethis::use_data.

nodes.name: pull_team_links.R
nodes.summary: KenPom scraping loop spanning seasons that harvests team and conference page links per year, joins against ncaahoopR dictionaries, and persists the bundled teams_links dataset.
nodes.languageNotes: Loops years with Sys.sleep throttling and uses collapse::funique to dedupe scraped link rows.

nodes.name: pull_team_page.R
nodes.summary: Large KenPom team-page harvester defining gather_team_pages() to scrape coaches, schedules, depth charts, and player stats per team and year into bundled data frames.
nodes.languageNotes: 807-line scraper iterating every team in hoopR::teams_links and parsing multiple tables per KenPom team page.

nodes.name: sdv_author_helpers.R
nodes.summary: Small helper script that summarizes installed-package authorship/maintainer fields to support SportsDataverse author/credit tabulation.

nodes.name: selenium try.R
nodes.summary: Experimental RSelenium scratch script launching headless Chrome to render and scrape the KenPom rankings table as an alternative to the rvest session approach.

nodes.name: team_page_calls.R
nodes.summary: Driver script that sources pull_team_page.R and invokes gather_team_pages() season-by-season (most calls commented out) against an authenticated KenPom session.

nodes.name: DESCRIPTION
nodes.summary: R package manifest for hoopR 3.1.0 declaring metadata, authors, MIT license, R >= 4.1 dependency, and Imports/Suggests (httr2, dplyr, rvest, data.table, etc.) for ESPN/NBA Stats/KenPom access.

nodes.name: hoopR.Rproj
nodes.summary: RStudio project configuration for the hoopR package setting build type, devtools usage, roxygenize outputs, and two-space-tab editing conventions.

nodes.name: NAMESPACE
nodes.summary: Roxygen2-generated package namespace exporting 270+ hoopR functions (bref_, cbbd_, espn_, kp_, nba_, load_, torvik_, realgm_ families) and registering the print.hoopR_data S3 method.

nodes.name: bref_awards.R
nodes.summary: Exports bref_awards(), scraping end-of-season NBA award voting (MVP, ROY, DPOY, etc.) from Basketball-Reference into a tidy hoopR_data tibble with one row per candidate.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps scraping in tryCatch with .report_api_error/.report_api_warning and returns a make_hoopR_data tibble.

nodes.name: bref_draft.R
nodes.summary: Exports bref_draft(), scraping NBA draft results with career totals and advanced metrics from Basketball-Reference into a tidy hoopR_data tibble, one row per pick.
nodes.languageNotes: Shares the .bref_text/.bref_table/.bref_type_convert helper pattern used across the bref_ family.
